title: Guard Robotron learning evidence before unattended game batches
body:
The current marathon runner can treat loss of player identity as the end of a game and press START again. Tracking, shadow diagnostics, and memory scaffolding exist, but they do not yet establish complete-game scores or score-improving policy learning.

This change requires explicit game-over evidence before another START, rejects ambiguous identity assignments and seeds, requires continuous E/S/W control-challenge matches, removes global appearance-only reacquisition, fixes reseeding against stale detections, adds elapsed-time shadow predictions with horizon-compatible evaluation, validates manual score records, and captures bounded review frames plus code/knowledge provenance. A new live-report review groups score, episode-end, and SELF questions across episodes without promoting them into learned strategy.

Validation: 155 tests passed; git diff --check clean. Pi hardware behavior is not yet validated.

title: Add Charlie memory, evidence evaluation, and PPAL-7 Pi gameplay setup
body:
Charlie needs durable, revisable task memory and a single Pi deployment containing the newer PPAL gameplay work.

This branch adds a durable SQLite MARM outbox, delivery timer, task recall gateway, head-search integration, evidence-based memory evaluator, and paired experiment runner. It includes a camera-only Robotron I/O adapter and reconciles the separate PPAL-7 snapshot with the memory-enabled PPAL demo.

The Pi gameplay loop now supports --remember to queue session evidence offline, with unique run IDs and explicit unknown rewards. The newer PPAL hindbrain, calibration, detection previews, and simulator learning tools are included. A Pi 5 installer and no-controller camera capture script are documented in docs/robotron-pi-start.md. Camera RGB conversion was corrected.

Validation: 62 combined offline tests passed, plus two targeted Pi integration regressions (64 total). Shell syntax checks passed. Published and local Git trees match.

Hardware limits: no Pi installation or live camera/controller validation has been performed here. Real-game detection profiles and HUD outcomes still need calibration. Live adaptive policy learning and automatic Robotron policy changes from recalled memories are not implemented. Synthetic learning remains separate from real-game improvement evidence. MARM server deployment remains a separate step; the delivery timer does not start the server.
